reuse.why: Reuses the existing link sequence, the ensureBankAccountNotLinked guard in the request wrapper, and extracts the Akahu download into downloadSingleProviderTransactions shared by Akahu and Fintegra.

duplication.why: No new copy of the link sequence or the download request; the only repetition is the per-request guard wrapper, which follows the tree's existing pattern.

placement.why: The generic link sequence is reached by bending linkAkahuAccount (provider parameter, provider-specific bank-key and sync-event branches) instead of a provider-neutral helper, so Fintegra behaviour now lives inside an Akahu-named function.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra; the widening of DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers is a small adjacent type fix.

maintainability.why: linkAkahuAccount now carries `provider === 'fintegra'` branches and a cast, and its public akahu-accounts-link request type silently accepts a `provider` argument that would skip the matching guard; each further provider would add more branches there.

bypasses_abstraction.where: fintegra-accounts-link goes through ensureBankAccountNotLinked and the existing link sequence; the download goes through the shared single-provider helper.

disguised_duplication.where: Logic is shared, not duplicated: linkFintegraAccount delegates to linkAkahuAccount and both downloads delegate to downloadSingleProviderTransactions.
